name: FFS_ACTIVITY_TMPL
description: Contains shift, mass, and repeating activities.

columns.name: TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of this repeating/mass/shift activity.

columns.name: USER_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the user who created this activity template.

columns.name: CREATED
columns.description: Activity template creation date.

columns.name: PARENT_TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: Reference to an previous template record.

columns.name: MASTER_TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: Reference to an initial template record.

columns.name: TEAM_RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: Activity Team holder resource reference. Used for teamwork activities.

columns.name: SHIFT_ID
columns.description: Reference to shift which activity template belongs.

columns.name: TYPE_ID
columns.description: Reference to Activity template Work Type List.

columns.name: WORK_ZONE_ID
columns.description: Activity template work zone reference . It is a read-only field that is automatically assigned to an activity, based on the company setting 'work zone key' and the activity properties.

columns.name: DURATION
columns.description: Activity template duration in minutes. Fills with actual duration after activity start.

columns.name: TIME_SLOT_ID
columns.description: Reference to time slot during which the activity template is completed. The time slot also indicates the service window for the activity. This time is displayed in the time zone of the resource to which the activity is assigned.

columns.name: SERVICE_WINDOW_START
columns.description: Activity template Service window start time. Service window is returned in the time zone of the resource to which the activity is currently assigned.

columns.name: SERVICE_WINDOW_END
columns.description: Activity template Service window end time. Service window is returned in the time zone of the resource to which the activity is currently assigned.

columns.name: ACTIVITY_NUMBER
columns.description: Identifier of the activity template in the origin system. The value can be empty.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_NUMBER
columns.description: Activity template account number of the customer. This field is used by integrations as a placeholder for the external identifier of the Account ID in the application. This parameter has no business significance in Oracle Field Service and can be left empty. Maximum field length is 40.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_NAME
columns.description: Activity template name of the customer. Maximum field length is 420.Encrypted.

columns.name: LOCATION_ID
columns.description: Deprecated. Will be removed soon.

columns.name: STREET_ADDRESS
columns.description: Activity template street address of the customer. This field is used for geocoding and must contain a valid address. Maximum field length is 240. Encrypted.

columns.name: CITY
columns.description: Activity template city of the customer where the activity is scheduled. Maximum field length is 60.

columns.name: POSTAL_CODE
columns.description: Activity template ZIP code of the customer where the activity is scheduled.

columns.name: STATE_PROVINCE
columns.description: Activity template state of the customer where the activity is scheduled. Maximum field length is 60.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_PHONE
columns.description: Activity template regular (land) phone number of the customer. . Encrypted.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_EMAIL
columns.description: Activity template email address of the customer. Maximum field length is 320.Encrypted.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_CELL
columns.description: Activity template cell phone number of the customer. Encrypted.

columns.name: LANGUAGE_ID
columns.description: Activity template language. Reference to Language.Lid.

columns.name: REMINDER_TIME
columns.description: Number of minutes before the activity template start time the customer must be notified of the activity.

columns.name: TIME_ZONE_ID
columns.description: Activity template Time Zone. Reference to Time_Zone.Zid.

columns.name: COORD_STATUS
columns.description: Activity template coordinates found staues: 'Is Found', 'Not_Found'.

columns.name: COORD_ACCURACY
columns.description: Activity template accuracy Level Of Geocoding Coordinates Not Valid - -1 Undefined - 0 Country - 1 State - 2 County - 3 City - 4 Zip - 5 Route - 6 Street - 7 Intersection - 8 Address - 9.

columns.name: COORD_X
columns.description: Geographic coordinates that specify the location of the activity template.

columns.name: COORD_Y
columns.description: Geographic coordinates that specify the location of the activity template.

columns.name: OPTIONS
columns.description: Bitmask. Set of options defining a behaviour of this activity.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Start date this activity takes effect from.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Last date until which this activity takes place. Optional.

columns.name: RECURRENCE
columns.description: Value of this parameter along with the 'Recur Every' parameter defines the time between each recurrence of the assignment (none, daily, weekly).

columns.name: WEEKDAYS
columns.description: Bitmask. Defines days of week this activity takes place.

columns.name: RECUR_EVERY
columns.description: Time between each recurrence of the assignment. Depending on the value selected for 'recurrence', the value of the parameter indicates the time between recurrence in days or weeks.

columns.name: SLA_START
columns.description: Time when the service level agreement (SLA) window starts. SLA window is returned in the time zone of the resource to which the activity template is currently assigned.

columns.name: SLA_END
columns.description: Time when the service level agreement (SLA) window ends. The time is displayed in 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' format. SLA window is returned in the time zone of the resource to which the activity template is currently assigned.

columns.name: FEATURES
columns.description: Bitmask field that defines active features for this activity template. This value is copied from a selected activity type on Create/Update actions.

columns.name: POINTS
columns.description: Number of Points that represent efforts required to perform this activity template.

columns.name: TIME_OF_BOOKING
columns.description: Time when the customer booked the activity template. The time is displayed in the time zone of the customer.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: COORD_VIEWPORT_RADIUS
columns.description: Radius of activity location viewport returned by geoprovider in meters.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: DELETED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the record is logically deleted (Y - soft deleted, N or NULL - active).
